content: Kubernetes official documentation defines Deployments as declarative controlled rollouts with rollout status and rollback history. Readiness removes a pod from service traffic, liveness restarts failed containers, and startup probes protect slow initialization. Oblivious should declare only deployment modes with journey and contract parity, stamp one immutable release identity across images and evidence, make worker and migration readiness explicit, and extract services incrementally only after ownership and parity gates pass.
